title.narrative: Food voucher project for the most needy families in Jordan

description.narrative: - Contributing to alleviating the burdens and meeting the needs of 864 families selected after applying criteria for a period of six months. - Enhancing food security for the targeted families during the assistance period. - Increasing access to basic food items to meet immediate food and nutritional needs for a period of six months.
Distribution of food coupons to needy families with at least five members. This value was determined based on the family's appropriate need. The coupons will be disbursed.
Enhancing and increasing food security for the needy and the most vulnerable families, and assisting heads of needy households in covering food expenses for their families and relatives.
